name: Hollow Abyss: Shattered Volition
desc:
>> ATTENTION - THIS IS A HARDCORE ROGUELIKE RPG WITH PERMANENT CHARACTER LOSS <<

Join the Libra's hivemind into a dark fantasy world where progress is nothing but pain. Learn abilities, obtain equipment, fight off curses or earn blessings, getting more powerful as the unforgiving tries to break you.

Explore Hollowed, a massive open-world map filled with points of interest, lore, end-game content, and dozens of unique classes. Master 21 different playstyles and hundreds of character build combinations. Unravel the Stella exploration system and Research, conquer PvE dungeon labyrinths, or clash against other players in intense PvP combat at Seften and the Theater of War—all while knowing that you are nothing but entertainment for the ones that watch from above.
— Step into the meatgrinder. Your failure has already been accounted for.

GUIDE:
Press M to access the world map.
Expand menu on the top left and guides for class tutorials.
